research_rationale: Complete one-page archival replica visually inspected, including operative text, signature/date, handwritten number 500 and later filing stamp. One command excuses Washington Navy Yard employees from work on Monday September 3, 1906. Annual language describes the 1894 Act in the recital; it does not extend this command to future years. Candidate own-term cessation is the close of 1906-09-03, with first post-window instant 1906-09-04; no performance assumption is needed for that temporal scope. This remains a blocked whole-case proposal because earlier-end coverage and required rendering method are not closed. No claim is ready; no original authentication or human certification.
savings_reason: No express savings or residual command appears in the complete page. Historical excuse for absence on the named day and any independently established accrued consequence are distinct from prospective work-excusal authority; do not infer that accrued consequences were extinguished. No payroll, actual attendance, payment or independent statutory-right finding is made.
